description: This file defines a React component named TodoItem used in a TypeScript-React TodoMVC application. It manages individual todo items, including editing, toggling completion, and destruction.

classes.name: TodoItem
classes.description: A React component representing a single todo item, with features for editing, toggling, and deleting the item.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles the submission of an edited todo item, saving or destroying based on input.

methods.name: handleEdit
methods.description: Triggers editing mode for the todo item.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events for committing or canceling edits based on key presses.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Updates the component's state as the user types in the edit field.

methods.name: shouldComponentUpdate
methods.description: Optimizes rerenders by comparing new and current props/state.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Focuses and selects the input field when editing begins.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Returns the JSX markup for displaying the todo item.
